items.title: Air Cargo Demand Accelerates in September, Up 7.7%
items.summary: IATA released data for September 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth across all regions, supported by stronger global trade and manufacturing.

items.title: IATA’s 2026 Global Passenger Survey: Travelers Embrace Biometrics and AI but Entry Requirements Remain a Barrier
items.summary: IATA released the results of its 2026 Global Passenger Survey (GPS), highlighting three major trends in passenger behavior and expectations.

items.title: Air New Zealand and Hong Kong International Airport First to Achieve IATA One ID Certification
items.summary: IATA announced that Air New Zealand and Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) are the first organizations to achieve One ID Certification.

items.title: IATA Highlights Priorities to Create Value from Digitalization
items.summary: IATA highlighted the challenge to turn advances in digitalization across airline retailing, payments, and digital identity into even better passenger journeys and a more efficient, financially resilient industry.

items.title: Payments Cost Airlines $24.5bn in 2025
items.summary: IATA has released new data demonstrating the rising cost burden of payment processing.

items.title: IATA Partners with OneVasco to Streamline Visa Applications
items.summary: IATA and OneVasco announced that OneVasco’s visa concierge service will be integrated into IATA’s Timatic Solutions.

items.title: Corporate Demand Could Support Up to 1.9 Million Tonnes of SAF by 2030
items.summary: IATA, Airbus, and Accenture released a SAF Environmental Attribute Certificate (EAc) Market study which estimates that corporate purchases could support between 1.0 million and 1.9 million tonnes of SAF by 2030, up from an estimated 323,000 tonnes in 2024.

items.title: IATA and World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance to Collaborate on Sustainable Hotel Procurement
items.summary: IATA and the World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance (WSHA) have agreed to strengthen alignment on sustainability between the airline and hospitality sectors.

items.title: ICAO Joins Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply
items.summary: IATA announced at its World Sustainability Symposium that the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) has joined the Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply (the Alliance).

items.title: Ten Years on from CORSIA Agreement, Governments Must Strengthen the Global Framework for Aviation Emissions
items.summary: IATA marked the tenth anniversary of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) assembly resolution to establish the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) with a call to governments to reinforce the foundations of this landmark step in aviation's decarbonization.

items.title: People, Technology, and Standards Together will Drive Safety Improvements
items.summary: IATA highlighted the need for stronger integration of people, technology, and global standards to deliver the next advances in aviation safety.

items.title: New Travel Industry Coalition Calls for EU Digital Omnibus to Enable Secure, Seamless Biometric Journeys
items.summary: Coalition seeks an effective and fair EU approach for responsible biometric travel to protect passenger choice, privacy and fundamental rights.

items.title: Air Passenger Demand Slips 0.8% in August
items.summary: IATA released data for August 2026 global passenger demand, showing a slight decline as the recovery trajectory for carriers in the Middle East was interrupted.

items.title: Air Cargo Demand Grows 4.4% in August
items.summary: IATA released data for August 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth in all regions, despite overall capacity contraction.

items.title: Cargo Screening Alone Cannot Solve Undeclared Dangerous Goods Risk
items.summary: IATA called for stronger, collaborative action across the air cargo supply chain in a multi-layered approach to counter the risks from undeclared and mis-declared dangerous goods.

items.title: IATA Brings World Passenger & Financial Symposium to Macao
items.summary: IATA will hold the joint World Financial Symposium (WFS) and World Passenger Symposium (WPS) on 28–29 October 2026 in Macao (SAR), China.

items.title: ICAO Council President to Open IATA Wings of Change Europe Event
items.summary: IATA announced that Toshiyuki Onuma, President of the Council of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), will open the Wings of Change Europe (WOCE) on 15 October in Brussels, Belgium, the heart of European policymaking.

items.title: IATA WSOC 2026 to Explore the Human Edge in Aviation Safety
items.summary: IATA announced that the 2026 World Safety and Operations Conference (WSOC) will focus on the human elements in keeping aviation safe and resilient. The event will take place from 6-8 October in Istanbul, Türkiye, hosted by Turkish Airlines

items.title: Pratt & Whitney Canada’s Contract Changes Are a Step Towards an Improved Engine Aftermarket
items.summary: IATA welcomed changes by Pratt & Whitney Canada to contractual terms that had raised competition concerns in the market for used engine parts.

items.title: IATA Releases 2027 Cargo and Ground Operations Manuals
items.summary: IATA has released the updated 2027 editions of key industry manuals for cargo and ground operations, which incorporate major changes and revisions to align with evolving global standards.

items.title: Fourth IATA World Sustainability Symposium to Take Place in Brussels as Air Transport Faces Critical Decarbonization Policy Decisions
items.summary: IATA will hold the fourth World Sustainability Symposium (WSS) in Brussels, Belgium, on 13-14 October 2026.

items.title: Air Passenger Demand Grows 0.2% in July
items.summary: IATA released data for July 2026 global passenger demand, showing a mostly positive Northern summer travel season, despite year-on-year declines in North America and the Middle East.

items.title: Air Cargo Demand Grows 3.9% in July
items.summary: IATA released data for July 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth in all regions, with airlines in Asia-Pacific, Europe, and North America accounting for more than 90% of the overall increase.

items.title: IATA Cargo Experts Conference: Turning Expertise into Improved Air Cargo Operations
items.summary: IATA announced that the 2026 IATA Cargo Experts Conference (CEC) will focus on practical ways to improve day-to-day air cargo operations through global standards, technology, and data.

items.title: Aviation Industry Urges African Governments to Align API and PNR Programs with Global Standards
items.summary: The African Airlines Association (AFRAA), the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA), and IATA urged African States to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in accordance with ICAO standards and global best practices.
